set: Bug-recorder replay ghosts (Lantern Grove VR mini golf)
units: studs; 1 Blender unit = 1 stud (1 stud = 0.28 m)
axes: Roblox Y-up; FBX axis_forward -Z, axis_up Y, transforms applied (identity objects)

assets.name: ghost_hand_left
assets.pivot: grip centre (centre of the closed mitt, where a club grip sits)
assets.orientation: fingers = Roblox -Z, thumb +Y, palm faces +X (toward body centre)

assets.name: ghost_hand_right
assets.pivot: grip centre (centre of the closed mitt, where a club grip sits)
assets.orientation: fingers = Roblox -Z, thumb +Y, palm faces -X (toward body centre)

assets.name: ghost_club
assets.pivot: grip end (top of the grip, on the shaft axis)

notes: ghost_club: no putter entry exists in lantern-grove/models/manifest.json; sized as a standard 34 in putter (3.05 studs grip end to sole). Scale on Y if the in-game putter differs.
ghost_ball: radius 0.08 stud from lantern-grove/holes.json ball_radius.
